chapter: The Paradise and life in Queens
title: Meeting his wife at the Savoy in Boston and the two Dale Streets
summary: His wife-to-be came to the Savoy with her mother and sister; he went to the wrong Dale Street before they married.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Another thing I wanted to go back to for a minute, you mentioned some time ago you were married in Boston and I wonder, you and your wife took an apartment there?

Yeah, an apartment, right. I was payin' six dollars a week, I had five rooms and my wife was, at the time, she always loved to cook and she was workin' for an antique dealer and she loved antiques and she came into the Savoy one night with her mother and her sister. Her mother was always crazy about me. I got her number and,

I'll never forget this, it was 17 Dale Street, but there was two Dale Streets in Boston. So I got in a cab and I rode to 17 Dale Street, but it was the wrong Dale Street. I says, "Oh," I was so upset because I really liked her. So she came back in there again and I says, "This is it, I'm gonna get it right this time." And it was another Dale Street. So we got married and she's a wonderful woman and we came to New York and...
Had she been going regularly to the Savoy?
Well, not that much. She liked music, but I don't think she came in there that much, you know...
But that is where you first met?
And she was with her mother?
